layout_fit.reason: The actual ANSI grids and pane headers verify 77x47 at natural 100%, with zero visible clipped graph items. Crossings are 0/0/0/1. The separately required live-pane columns/rectangle remain missing for all four panes (MM-L01); that evidence gap does not downgrade the known avoidable-crossing failure to blocked.

conceptual_grouping_color.reason: Declared families match the source roles rather than geometric depth. Captured normal colors support control cp/wapi teal shades in v1, registry/providers blue shades in v1, machine/boot/agent teal shades in v2, q/janitor amber and SSH/machines teal in v3, reconcile/queue amber and private/public gRPC teal in v4. findings.description: DEFECT: No route has a visible dot at its arrowhead at 2000ms; all 24 occurrences have zero visible dots in pane frame 20. Across frames 1-20, 90/480 route-frames have no dot, and short routes disappear before long routes. This contradicts the requested one-live-dot-per-line visible common arrival and the --check claim of synchronized rendered arrival at 2000ms; it is not merely a waived legibility issue.

DEFECT: On 20 directly observable labeled frame-0 routes, the dot is on the second drawn edge cell, one cell beyond the actual first cell after the source port. Static and timestamped geometry registration establishes this without using the spec as motion proof. Three additional offset positions are only in untimestamped pane tails, and allocation has no frame-0 dot evidence; those are not silently promoted to direct proof.
